fragility.issue: eran2 is single point of failure for eran1<->eran3 traffic
fragility.detail: no direct QSFP between eran1 and eran3; if eran2 down, mesh splits into {eran1} and {eran3, eran4}
fragility.mitigation_available: physically install one QSFP DAC between eran1 spare port and eran3 spare port (both have 2 unused ports each)

fragility.issue: eran4 is single-homed via eran3 enP7s7 (10G RJ45)
fragility.detail: eran4 reachable only through eran3; loss of eran3 OR the RJ45 cable takes eran4 offline; also caps eran4 aggregate throughput at 10G
fragility.mitigation_available: cable eran4 to eran2 as second uplink

fragility.issue: latent 400G potential between eran1<->eran2 and eran2<->eran3
fragility.detail: each pair has 2x200G cables in; only 1x200G is L3-configured. Could bond (LACP) for 400G or hot-standby.
fragility.mitigation_available: config bond0 on both ends, or add /30 to spare pair as backup route
